name: LI Gift Basket — Celebration Auto-Greeting (Email + WhatsApp)

parameters.jsCode:
// Build personalized email and WhatsApp messages const cel = $json; const daysText = cel.daysUntil === 0 ? 'TODAY' : `in ${cel.daysUntil} day${cel.daysUntil > 1 ? 's' : ''}`; const urgency = cel.daysUntil <= 1 ? '🚨 LAST CHANCE: ' : cel.daysUntil <= 3 ? '⏰ Almost time: ' : '📅 Coming up: '; // Email subject const subject = `${cel.emoji} ${urgency}${cel.name} — ${cel.discount}% OFF Gift Baskets!`; // Email HTML body const emailHtml = `
${cel.emoji}

${cel.name}

Just ${daysText} away!

Dear Valued Customer,

${cel.name} is ${daysText}! Celebrate with a beautiful gift basket from LI Gift Basket — Long Island\'s favorite gift shop in Plainview, NY.

${cel.discount}% OFF
Use code:
${cel.code}

🎁 Gift baskets starting from just $35
🚚 Free delivery across Nassau & Suffolk County on orders $60+
🎀 Custom baskets available for any budget

Shop Now 🛍️
LI Gift Basket | Plainview, Long Island, NY 11803
Unsubscribe
`; // WhatsApp message const whatsapp = `${cel.emoji} *${urgency.replace(/:/,'').trim()}* ${cel.name} is ${daysText}!\n\nCelebrate with a beautiful gift basket from LI Gift Basket 🎁\n\n✨ *${cel.discount}% OFF* with code: *${cel.code}*\n🚚 Free delivery on Long Island\n🎀 Custom baskets from $35\n\n👉 https://ligiftbasket.com\n\n📍 Plainview, Long Island, NY`; return [{ json: { ...cel, emailSubject: subject, emailHtml, whatsappMessage: whatsapp } }];

meta.description: Sends celebration greetings with discount offers via Gmail + WhatsApp for every major US/NY holiday. Runs daily at 9 AM EST. Fires 7 days before, 3 days before, 1 day before, and day-of each celebration. Import into n8n and configure Gmail + Twilio credentials.
meta.business: LI Gift Basket — Plainview, Long Island, NY
